findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_feedback_reply · Private data: split_role · Public sink: split_role, submit_feedback · Destructive: submit_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_feedback_reply · Private data: split_role · Public sink: split_role, submit_feedback · Destructive: submit_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
